mathematical_justification.clause: All named quantities and G1 domain
mathematical_justification.assessment: TreeDataEqual is a transparent conjunction quantifying over every actual BoundaryInterval and raw IntervalComposition, comparing ordinaryWeight and rootWeight, then every openTreeSum and the treeCoefficient at the chosen root. A_chamber first quantifies over arbitrary labelled tuples with G1 proofs and equality of all actual chi entries. The already checked sign/weight congruence theorems give equal weight functions; substituting these functions into the defined recursion gives equal open and rooted sums. No G2, regularity, nonzero-control oracle or unproved constancy is added. The independent complete_G1_quantities consumer extracts every source quantity on this precise domain.

The labelled chamber in the source formalization remark is the actual connected component of GenericTuple, not the locus of a fixed sign pattern used as a replacement definition. continuous_generic_chi maps this space continuously to discrete SignType. Preconnectedness of a connected component forces each chi entry to be constant, yielding the full data equality. The independent actual_connected_component consumer begins directly with Q in connectedComponent P and obtains TreeDataEqual, verifying the domain is exactly the topological component.

The source states that a polygon has no distinguished edge and a needed root is part of the construction data (sm-1 lines33-38), explicitly permits labelled tuples with shift-equivariance (lines55-60), and requires the simultaneous rule (P,g)->(shift a P,g-a) in def:root. Consequently constancy of A_g on a chamber uses the same physical-root choice under representative changes; it does not assert that selecting fixed label zero afresh on every representative defines an unrooted invariant. The proved chamber preimage formula expresses the actual quotient component as a union of shifted labelled components. A_chamber exposes one a with Q in the actual labelled component of genericShift a P and transports every root g coherently to g-a. This is the source permitted representative interpretation, strengthened by explicit quotient transport, without presuming independence of different physical roots.

countersignature_20260913.reason: SM.A_chamber (work/lean/SM/TreeChamber.lean:92-105) is a four-part conjunction whose parts 1, 2 and 4 are exactly the three clauses of the SM15 text (sm-2-amplitude.tex:121-126), read on labelled representatives as def:polygon's formalization remark permits. Clause 1: for all LabelledTuple P Q with G1 P, G1 Q and (∀ i j k, chi P i j k = chi Q i j k), for every root g, TreeDataEqual — which is literally "every composition weight (ordinaryWeight = V^+, rootWeight = V^-, for every BoundaryInterval and every IntervalComposition), every b_[i,j] (openTreeSum for every I) and A_g (treeCoefficient) agree". Clause 2 (the SM15-reworded sentence): for P Q : GenericTuple n (G1 ∧ G2 = 𝒰_n) with Q ∈ labelledChamber P = connectedComponent P in the subtype of ZMod n → ℝ×ℝ (standard topology, no custom instances), for every fixed g, TreeDataEqual — this is constancy on every labelled chamber with the root fixed, matching SM15 exactly. Clause 4: for any Mathlib Path in {P // G1 P} with constant chirotope, the data at any two times s t agree — the printed path clause with its printed constant-chirotope premise. The underlying definitions denote the printed objects: boundaryIndex g k = g+k+1 (a_k = μ_{g+k+1}), BoundaryInterval = 0 ≤ i < j ≤ n-1, IntervalComposition = strictly increasing cuts r_0=i,…,r_s=j with s ≥ 1, nearSign/farSign = χ(a_{r_{k+1}},a_{r_k},a_{r_{k-1}}) / χ(a_j,a_{r_k},a_i) with chi = sign det(y-x, z-x), ordinaryGate/rootGate = d·Θ(∓hd) with Θ(1)=1, Θ(-1)=0, openTreeRec = the b recursion (1 on one leaf, minus sum over |π| ≥ 2), treeCoefficient = Σ_π over all compositions of [0,n-1] of V^-(π)∏b. Nothing is vacuous and no hypothesis beyond the printed ones is added. The Lean is strictly stronger in two places (listed) and nowhere weaker. Regarding sm15_reworded: the accepted Lean statement matches the SM15 wording "constant on every labelled chamber (the root fixed)" precisely (clause 2 uses labelledChamber, not the quotient chamber, and evaluates both sides at the same g); the old SM12 unlabelled-chamber reading is covered only as the separate, correctly root-shifted extra clause 3. After forming this judgement I compared with work/reviews/prop-A-chamber.json, which reaches the same conclusion.
stronger_than_source: Clause 2 (TreeChamber.lean:96-97) asserts constancy on each labelled chamber of ALL of TreeDataEqual (every V^+, V^-, every b_[i,j] and A_g), whereas SM15 line 123-124 only asserts 'A_g is constant on every labelled chamber (the root fixed)'.

Clause 3 (TreeChamber.lean:98-101) is an extra statement not in the SM15 text: for P Q : GenericTuple with polygonProjection Q in the unlabelled chamber of polygonProjection P, there is a shift a with Q ∈ labelledChamber (genericShift a P) and treeCoefficient Q (g - a) = treeCoefficient P g for every g. This is consistent with def:root (sm-2-amplitude.tex:12-14: the shift carries root g of P to root g-1 of σP; shift 1 = σ per Polygon.lean:21-23) and def:chamber (sm-1-polygons.tex:206-211), but SM15 deliberately restricted the chamber clause to labelled chambers with the root fixed.
